object.name: TxGraffiti Conjecture 15/3
object.statement: Every finite simple r-regular graph G with r>0 satisfies i(G) <= mu_star(G).

formula_graph_identity.statement: For an indexed CNF F on k variables, with clauses treated as literal sets, i(G(F)) = k + beta(F), where beta is minimum bilateral deficiency.
formula_graph_identity.predecessor_independent_analysis: re-derived by Fable on v2-theorem, not exact v4
formula_graph_identity.novelty: targeted search did not locate an equivalent published statement; no priority claim

twice_occurrence_case.statement: For a proper indexed 3-CNF in which every positive and negative literal occurs exactly twice, G(F) is cubic and mu_star(G(F))=k.
twice_occurrence_case.prior_art: the exact signed occurrence formula class and clause-literal architectures predate this release

restricted_dim_threshold.statement: Assuming the published 20-clause threshold for unsatisfiable (3,2,2)-formulas, every cubic graph with a dominating induced matching and fewer than 50 vertices satisfies i(G)<=mu_star(G).

proof.mu_star_lower_bound: 75 edges / at most 5 edges dominated per selected matching edge = 15
proof.optional_cross_check: generic SciPy/HiGHS MILPs return i=16 and mu_star=15 with zero reported gaps

audit_of_input.exact_recurrences: appear sound within n<=32 and m<=64
audit_of_input.main_theoretical_error: classified the DIM endpoint formula only as (3,4)-CNF and placed the restricted frontier at order 40 rather than 50

limitations: No proof of unrestricted order-50 minimality or uniqueness.
No exact-v4 independent rerun or clean-room reimplementation.
No proof-assistant formal verification or conventional peer review.
The restricted order theorem depends on an external computational threshold that is not re-derived in the release.
Targeted novelty search does not exclude unindexed or uninspected prior work.
The declarative container has not been built in the authoring environment.
